raw.hotelDescription:
Set within a trio of sleek glass high-rises, this luxury hotel is 2 km from both the Old City and the Caspian Sea.
 Featuring city or sea views, the upscale rooms come with Wi-Fi, flat-screens and iPod docks, plus Nespresso machines and marble bathrooms. Club-level rooms come with butler service and access to an exclusive lounge. Suites add living rooms; some feature kitchens and dining areas. Room service is available 24/7.
 There's an elegant Mediterranean restaurant, plus a chic lobby bar, a jazz bar and a cigar lounge. The rooftop pool has a hot tub and bar service. A spa features pools, a gym, a yoga studio, and a cafe. Breakfast is extra.
